correspondences.notes: No BIDS counterpart for connectome-quality scores.

brainlife.desc: JSON output of the Connectome Evaluator App: a LiFE-based estimate of how well the DWI supports connectome mapping.
brainlife.name: neuro/conneval
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Judging DWI quality for connectome mapping, shown in the Connectome Evaluator viewer.

**Not for:** Use as a tractogram or connectivity matrix; it holds only summary scores.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.conneval.json

files.desc: JSON with the connectome evaluation results.

identifying_risks: Rows or file names may carry subject and session codes
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level data-quality measures without direct identifiers; they reveal little about the person.
sharing_cautions: Use coded subject IDs and drop dates
tier_conditions: Tier 1 once reduced to group statistics with no participant rows

intended_use: Judging DWI quality for connectome mapping, shown in the Connectome Evaluator viewer.
